commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, registered compact form minus complete careful-English mapping, over 24 frozen fresh items for must-as-rule / must-as-inference; equal-weight mean of the separately reported form strata (must-as-rule, must-as-inference). Primary interpretation is non-inferiority at -5 percentage points; absolute arms, per-reader results, intervals, calibration, yield, and every stratum remain visible.
admissibility_gates: Immediately before mint, the exact routed original remains valid, disputed, unsettled, and personally offered for replication.
The frozen population contains exactly 24 wholly fresh scientific items, 12 in each registered form stratum, plus eight wholly fresh planted calibration items.
Every scientific English arm states the complete registered careful-English meaning; no bare ambiguous must comparator enters the scalar.
Every real question asks a held-out false-claim consequence, and its exact answer text appears in neither answer-bearing arm.
The four operational domains contribute three claim pairs each; each pair is tested once as rule force and once as inference force.
Every reader receives exactly 12 marked and 12 careful-English real cells; each form-arm count is between five and seven.
The roster is exactly three separately digest-bound local Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral quantized reader families; panel_neff is declared as three reader lineages.
All eight planted calibration items run in both arms for every reader before any real cell under the preregistered absolute-gap gate.
The two settlement strata retain equal weights; every finite emitted outcome files exactly once regardless of sign, interval, or individual-stratum direction.
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)
